# Web Install

Web platform documentation including JavaScript library setup, tag management integrations, and server-side SDKs.

## About markdown versions

All pages in this area are available in clean markdown format. To access the markdown version of any page, append `/index.md` to the page URL.

Example:
- HTML: `https://docs.tealium.com/iq-tag-management/getting-started/what-is-tealium-iq/`
- Markdown: `https://docs.tealium.com/iq-tag-management/getting-started/what-is-tealium-iq/index.md`


## Install


- [Module list: AppData module](https://docs.tealium.com/platforms/prism-mobile/module-list/appdata/): Adds information about the app bundle to the data layer.

- [Module list: Collect module](https://docs.tealium.com/platforms/prism-mobile/module-list/collect/): Dispatches tracking calls to the Tealium Collect service.

- [Module list: ConnectivityData module](https://docs.tealium.com/platforms/prism-mobile/module-list/connectivitydata/): Monitors network connectivity and adds connection information to all tracking events.

- [Module list: Context API module](https://docs.tealium.com/platforms/prism-mobile/module-list/moments-api/): Retrieve real-time visitor profile data using the Context API module (formerly Moments API) in the Tealium Prism SDK.

- [Module list: DeepLinkHandler module](https://docs.tealium.com/platforms/prism-mobile/module-list/deep-link/): Track deep links and attribute them to campaigns or referrers.

- [Module list: DeviceData module](https://docs.tealium.com/platforms/prism-mobile/module-list/devicedata/): Automatically adds device information to all tracking events.

- [Module list: Firebase dispatcher](https://docs.tealium.com/platforms/prism-mobile/module-list/firebase-dispatcher/): Send Tealium Prism events to Firebase Analytics on iOS and Android with the Firebase dispatcher module.

- [Module list: Lifecycle module](https://docs.tealium.com/platforms/prism-mobile/module-list/lifecycle/): Tracks app lifecycle events such as launch, wake, and sleep.

- [Module list: Moments AI module](https://docs.tealium.com/platforms/prism-mobile/module-list/moments-ai/): Configure on-device AI inference for mobile profiles using the Moments AI module.

- [Module list: Moments iQ module](https://docs.tealium.com/platforms/prism-mobile/module-list/moments-iq/): Configure in-app survey and experience widgets using the Moments iQ module for mobile profiles.

- [Module list: TealiumData module](https://docs.tealium.com/platforms/prism-mobile/module-list/tealiumdata/): Adds core Tealium SDK metadata to the data layer for every tracking event.

- [Module list: TimeData module](https://docs.tealium.com/platforms/prism-mobile/module-list/timedata/): Adds timestamp data to all tracking calls.

- [Tealium Shopify App: About Tealium Shopify app](https://docs.tealium.com/platforms/shopify/about/): This article provides information about the Tealium application in the Shopify Marketplace.

- [API Reference: Cookie Functions](https://docs.tealium.com/platforms/javascript/api/cookie-functions/): Reference guide for cookie functions provided by Tealium for JavaScript.

- [Tealium for Salesforce: Install](https://docs.tealium.com/platforms/salesforce/install/): This article explains how to install and configure the Tealium for Salesforce using Apex classes and triggers to track Lead and Contact updates with Tealium Collect.

- [Data Layer: An Introduction to the Data Layer](https://docs.tealium.com/platforms/getting-started-web/data-layer/an-introduction-to-the-data-layer/): This article introduces the data layer and explains what it is, how it works, and the benefits of implementing one.

- [API Reference: GDPR Functions](https://docs.tealium.com/platforms/javascript/api/gdpr-functions/): Reference guide for GDPR functions provided by Tealium for JavaScript.

- [Tealium Shopify App: Tealium configuration](https://docs.tealium.com/platforms/shopify/tealium-shopify-configuration/): This article provide information about the Tealium configuration steps that should be completed before installing the Tealium Shopify app.
